summary.text: Angel Charley is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 30, which covers parts of Bernalillo, Cibola, McKinley, Socorro and Valencia counties.
Charley sits on the Senate Conservation Committee and the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Charley's legislative page lists a district office in Acoma.

Between sessions, Charley serves as vice chair of the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee and as a member of the Indian Affairs, Land Grant, Radioactive and Hazardous Materials, and Behavioral Health committees.
